articles.headline: World Cup live updates: Norway take on England in quarterfinal clash
articles.description: Enjoy all the updates from Saturday's match as Norway take on England in Miami Gardens in 2026 FIFA World Cup quarterfinal action.

articles.headline: Jordan Pickford breaks Peter Shilton's record for most England World Cup appearances
articles.description: Jordan Pickford has broken the record for most England World Cup appearances after featuring in Saturday's quarterfinal against Norway.

articles.headline: World Cup daily: Free England-Norway ticket in Haaland look-alike contest
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the 2026 FIFA World Cup as we have our final two quarterfinals.

articles.headline: Jordan Henderson: Breaking arm in England celebrations 'was not my finest hour'
articles.description: England midfielder Jordan Henderson joked it was "not my finest hour" after he suffered a broken arm while celebrating the World Cup round of 16 win over Mexico last weekend.

articles.headline: Ezri Konsa starts for England at right-back against Norway as John Stones, Noni Madueke come into team
articles.description: England have made two changes and a further positional switch for their World Cup quarterfinal with Norway in Miami on Saturday.

articles.headline: Jürgen Klopp reaches agreement on 'key points' of deal to become new Germany head coach
articles.description: Jürgen Klopp has reached an agreement on the "key points" of a deal to become the new Germany head coach, the German football federation has said.
